blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres expressed admiration for Ifugao’s centuries-old rice terraces and local traditions during a two-day visit to the province following the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit in Manila. According to a statement released by the Department of Tourism-Cordillera Administrative Region (DOT-CAR), Guterres visited Ifugao on Nov. 18 and 19, touring several rice terraces and spending time with a local family. “I just spent some time with a family here in Ifugao, and it’s amazing – their culture, traditions, and very strong connection to their land,” Guterres said, as quoted in the DOT-CAR […]...
